skill_name: Name some different types of magnetic materials.
workflow: Magnetic materials can be broadly classified into three categories: ferromagnetic materials, paramagnetic materials, and diamagnetic materials. Ferromagnetic materials are strongly attracted to magnets and can retain a magnetic field. Examples of ferromagnetic materials include iron, cobalt, nickel, and some alloys.
